Note to self: LoRA update for transformer block

Attention block review

Token embedding \((h_1, \dots, h_t)\) flows through a transformer block as this, using \(h_t\) as an example \[ h_t \to h'_{t}= h_t + \text{Attention}(h_1, \dots, h_{t}) \to h''_t = h_t' + \text{MLP}(h'_t). \]

  • For attention layer with \(k\)-attention heads , we have \(\{W_{Q, i}\}_{1\leq i\leq \frac{d}{k}}\), \(\{W_{K, i}\}_{1\leq i\leq \frac{d}{k}}\), and \(\{W_{V, i}\}_{1\leq i\leq \frac{d}{k}}\) where each \(W\) matrix is of dimension \(\mathbb{R}^{\frac{d}{k} \times d}\). For any given token \(h\), we have

\[ \text{Attention}(h_1, \dots, h_{t}) = \text{Attention}_{head_1}(h_1, \dots, h_t) \oplus \dots \oplus \text{Attention}_{head_k}(h_1, \dots, h_t) \in \mathbb{R}^{d}. \]

​ Attention modifies a token’s representation using other tokens it can attend to.

  • For the MLP block \[ \text{MLP}(h_t') = W_{down} \sigma(W_{up}h'_t + b_{up})\in \mathbb{R}^d. \] The MLP detects learned features in that updated representation and produces a vector adjustment

LoRA update for transformer block

We update the Query and Value matrix, while keeping the Key matrix unchanged.

Part of the block Classic query/value LoRA setup
Query projection (W_Q) Add trainable (sB_QA_Q)
Key projection (W_K) Keep frozen
Value projection (W_V) Add trainable (sB_VA_V)
Attention output projection (W_O) Keep frozen
MLP up and down projections Keep frozen
Layer normalization parameters Keep frozen

Note that keeping the key matrix frozen is mainly a choice about which parameters to adapt, rather than a requirement to avoid multiplying trainable weights. Intuitively, with frozen keys, LoRA changes what each token’s query looks for while keeping the keys it searches against fixed.
